finding: The soundtrack binding is additive and does not alter the accepted Audralia world renderer, geographic continuity, camera/travel controls, cloud/weather presentation, terrain, coast, or scale-transition semantics. The only owner-visible visual additions are a soundtrack toggle in the existing toolbar and attribution in the existing help footer. The accepted H-Earth same-world anchor remains applicable.
